$schema: Unit title and note overrides for course.zh.json (Phase 9 §1). Reviewable data, hand-edited like topics.json and overrides.json; the build merges it over the generated draft.
$notes: titles: unitId -> replacement title, when the drafted title reads wrong.
notes:  WORD (simp) -> one-sentence pattern observation, shown on the unit that introduces
that word. Authored only for words whose pattern is worth naming; topical vocab
(Food, Places, People) genuinely has no single pattern and gets none.
Keyed by word, NOT by unit id: unit ids move whenever the course is re-cut (Phase 11 §2
re-scheduled them, Phase 12 merged stragglers), and id-keyed notes silently drifted onto
the wrong units both times — a note about 几 ended up on a band-5 unit. A spelling never
moves. Same reasoning as topics.json and lessons.json keying by simp.

notes.吗: 吗 at the end of a statement turns it into a yes/no question.
notes.会: 会 is a learned ability; 能 is a circumstantial possibility.
notes.呢: 呢 bounces a question back (你呢?) or marks "what about…".
notes.有: 有 is "to have" and "there is" — negate it with 没有, never 不有.
notes.这: 这 "this" and 那 "that" take a measure word before the noun: 这本书.
notes.着: 着 after a verb marks an ongoing state: 开着门.
notes.应该: 应该 "should" goes before the verb: 你应该去.
notes.个: 个 is the default measure word — use it when unsure which one a noun takes.
notes.了: 了 after a verb marks a completed or changed action.
notes.能: 能 asks or grants possibility: 能帮我吗?
notes.想: 想 is "would like to"; 要 is a firmer "want to / will".
notes.还: 还 is "still / also"; 再 is "again", for an action not yet repeated.
notes.比: 比 compares: A 比 B + adjective — 我比你高.
notes.就: 就 says something happens sooner or easily; 才 that it takes longer.
notes.让: 让 "to let / make someone do" takes a person, then a verb: 让我看看.
notes.最: 最 marks the superlative: 最好 "best".
notes.几: 几 asks "how many" for small counts, 多少 for larger or open ones.
notes.请: 请 before a verb makes a polite request: 请坐.
notes.虽然: 虽然… 但是… keeps both halves of "although… still…".
notes.从: 从… 到… traces "from… to…" in space or time.
